text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2024. Earth-observation data confirms a 0.7-hectare tree-cover loss event in 2023, with an additional 0.7-hectare loss in 2024. The total loss after the 2020 baseline is 1.4 hectares, or about 2.4% of the property. The evidence is corroborated by multiple sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map.
